answer: A payout is split thus 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The falcon schedule is applied in mesa and ripple shows each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 852 identities would post 4170 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
